question: Can a patient with eGFR of 20 mL/min/1.73m2 and UACR of 150 mg/g enroll in this dapagliflozin trial, and what daily dose would they receive if eligible?

expected_spans.quote: eGFR >= 25 and <= 75 mL/min/1.73m2 (CKD-EPI Formula) at visit 1
10 mg or 5 mg tablets given once daily, per oral use

rationale: Patient eGFR 20 is BELOW the minimum of 25, so excluded. UACR 150 is also below the minimum of 200. Both inclusion thresholds must be met. Cross-references two separate inclusion criteria with the dosing information.

question: Would a patient with type 1 diabetes who had a kidney transplant 2 years ago be eligible for this trial, and what is the primary composite endpoint?

expected_spans.quote: Time to the First Occurrence of Any of the Components of the Composite: >= 50% Sustained Decline in eGFR, End Stage Kidney Disease, Renal Death or Cardiovascular Death

rationale: Two independent exclusion criteria apply (type 1 diabetes AND organ transplantation history), both blocking enrollment. Then connects to the primary composite endpoint. Three sections synthesized.

question: What prior medication must a patient be stabilized on before enrollment, and what happens if they were previously intolerant to the study drug class?

expected_spans.quote: Stable, and for the patient maximum tolerated labelled daily dose, treatment with ACE-I or ARB for at least 4 weeks before visit 1, if not medically contraindicated
Receiving therapy with an SGLT2 inhibitor within 8 weeks prior to enrolment or previous intolerance of an SGLT2 inhibitor
Dapagliflozin ... 10 mg or 5 mg tablets given once daily

rationale: Requires connecting the ACE-I/ARB stabilization requirement (inclusion) with the SGLT2 inhibitor washout/intolerance exclusion. Dapagliflozin IS an SGLT2 inhibitor, so prior intolerance excludes. Three sections: inclusion criteria, exclusion criteria, and interventions.

question: If a patient had a myocardial infarction 10 weeks before screening, can they enroll? What cardiovascular endpoint is tracked as a secondary outcome, and who is blinded to treatment assignment?

expected_spans.quote: MI, unstable angina, stroke or transient ischemic attack within 12 weeks prior to enrolment
Time to the First Occurrence of Either of the Components of the Composite: Cardiovascular Death or Hospitalization for Heart Failure
Masking: QUADRUPLE ... Who Masked: PARTICIPANT, CARE_PROVIDER, INVESTIGATOR, OUTCOMES_ASSESSOR

rationale: MI 10 weeks ago is within the 12-week exclusion window, so the patient is excluded. Then connects to the CV secondary endpoint and the quadruple masking design. Three sections: exclusion criteria, secondary outcomes, and study design.
